collection.attribution: Nathan Hagen, LensLibrary; original design cited below when the source states it

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: SOURCE_STATED air wavelengths at 20 C and 101325 Pa, converted once to vacuum with the Edlen 1953 air model

operating_range_nm.note: one stated sampling wavelength; the band is a 1 nm numerical interval around it, not a claimed operating range

back_focal_length_mm.definition: from the last surface vertex to the paraxial image point

total_track_mm.definition: first surface vertex to the image plane along the axis

engine_check.method: thick-lens paraxial ABCD through the committed Project's COMPOUND unit

numerical_aperture.definition: object-space numerical aperture as stated by the source

f_number.definition: image-space f-number (paraxial working f-number of the dump)

field.definition: object-space field height, the largest stated field point
field.basis: SOURCE_STATED (the upstream prescription dump's field table)
field.convention: the property list states the full object-space field; the prescription dump's field table states the largest field point, which is half of it

named_glasses.name: BK7
named_glasses.basis: constant index 1.5171190102105037 at the single stated wavelength 590.163503 nm

named_glasses.name: COC
named_glasses.basis: constant index 1.5340425954271937 at the single stated wavelength 590.163503 nm

named_glasses.name: POLYSTYR
named_glasses.basis: constant index 1.5906882879067834 at the single stated wavelength 590.163503 nm

materials.policy: Every glass is defined from the source's own per-surface index table in the upstream prescription dump: a 3-term Sellmeier with fixed poles solved to those samples, or a constant index when the source states one wavelength. Published catalog glasses are compared, never substituted.

approximations.detail: the source gives no stop-plate outer radius; the plate reaches the largest clear semi-diameter beside the stop
the source gives clear semi-diameters only, so each surface is edged at its own clear semi-diameter
nominal prescription surfaces; no figure, centring or surface-roughness error is modelled

notes: project check accepted the committed Project with os-optics 0.14.0
project solids reported no error-severity finding
the engine's paraxial EFL and BFL reproduce the source-stated values within the stated tolerance
